title: Static Rounded-Thorax Unequal-Four-Wing Bumblebee
description: One complete newly authored stylised static bumblebee-like insect. A broad rounded head joins a very stout rounded thorax and a short large bulbous tapered abdomen; the integral body has real thick mass rather than the old butterfly slender axis or ant nodal waist. Two long swept oval forewings and two shorter rear wings are distinct full thick solids rooted into the thorax, six complete bent legs end in finite grounded toes, two curved non-clubbed antennae and two large lateral eye masses finish the head. Muted warm/dark bands are integral body face materials and only secondary recognition; whole body, wing outlines and limbs newly authored. One static model, zero scenes. Opaque stylised wings, not translucent membrane or microscopic veins; no fur simulation, species/anatomy precision, flight, pollination, stinging, behaviour or rig claim.
